headline: Obsc Perfection receives Rs 24.5 crore nomination from US auto major
summary: Obsc Perfection received a Rs 24.5 crore nomination letter from a US-based auto components manufacturer for a 5-year supply contract. This adds to a robust Q3FY27 order book of Rs 103.40 crore, with total disclosed backlog at Rs 155.20 crore.

headline: Sahaj Solar bags Rs 389.52 cr order from CEB Mauritius
summary: Sahaj Solar has secured a Rs 389.52 crore order from Central Electricity Board, Mauritius, for hybrid solar and battery energy storage systems. The deal involves 25-year ownership by its subsidiary.

headline: Rama Telecom wins Rs 15.88 Cr order from Central Railway
summary: Rama Telecom received a Letter of Acceptance for Rs 15.88 Cr from Central Railway. This confirmed order represents significant backlog addition for the SME telecom firm.

headline: Ircon fined ₹7.69 lakh by NSE, BSE for board norms
summary: Ircon International Ltd faces a ₹7.69 lakh fine from NSE and BSE for Q2FY27 non-compliance with board composition rules. The company cites government appointment delays as the cause.

headline: Paisalo Digital opens NCD issue Dec 2
summary: Paisalo Digital Ltd launches Tranche II NCD public issue up to ₹20,000 lakh. Subscription opens December 2, 2026, with coupons up to 10.47% for retail investors.

headline: Kec wins Rs 1407 Cr composite order in Africa, India, Americas
summary: Kec International secures Rs 1407 crore composite order for T&D, railway, and cable projects. Order book covers 3.07 quarters of revenue. Q2FY27 net profit dipped to Rs 29.70 Cr.

headline: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam fined ₹14.23 lakh by BSE
summary: BSE imposed a penalty of ₹14,23,080 on Mahanagar Telephone Nigam for non-compliance with SEBI (LODR) governance regulations regarding board composition and committee structures.

headline: SEBI issues order against Raj Kumar Yadav
summary: SEBI has issued an order against Raj Kumar Yadav in the matter of M/s Real Sunshine Corp Limited, marking a regulatory action by the capital markets regulator.

headline: Coal India fined ₹10.57 lakh by BSE and NSE
summary: Coal India Limited received a penalty of ₹10.57 lakh each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations regarding board composition.

headline: Vipul Ltd clarifies Algoquant's 5.26% holding
summary: Vipul Ltd clarified that Algoquant Fintech's aggregate holding, including PACs, crossed 5% in August 2026, triggering SEBI SAST disclosure requirements.

headline: Promoter Krishanu Agrawal acquires 6,000 shares in Hariyana Ventures
summary: Krishanu Harish Agrawal acquired 6,000 equity shares of Hariyana Ventures Ltd via off-market mode, raising his stake to 4.61% as of November 26, 2026.

headline: JSW Energy subsidiary acquires Sapana Sakar for ₹22 crore
summary: JSW Renew Energy Seventeen, a step-down subsidiary of JSW Energy, agreed to acquire 100% equity in Sapana Sakar Buildcon for ₹22 crore to accelerate a 100 MW renewable project.

headline: Decillion Finance promoter exits holding
summary: Promoter Jitendra Kumar Goyal sold 70,100 shares (2.00%) in Decillion Finance via open market, reducing his personal stake to zero. Group holding remains at 34.85%.

headline: Apollo Micro Systems gets in-principle approval for preferential issue
summary: Apollo Micro Systems received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for issuing 1.74 crore equity shares and 5.68 crore warrants on a preferential basis.

headline: Prabhu Steel promoter buys 9,400 shares
summary: Krishanu Harish Agrawal acquired 9,400 equity shares of Prabhu Steel Industries Ltd on November 26, 2026, taking his holding to 1.31% via off-market transaction.

headline: Heritage Foods CEO resigns effective Dec 31, 2026
summary: Srideep Madhavan Nair Kesavan resigns as CEO of Heritage Foods due to personal reasons. He will be relieved on December 31, 2026, after five years leading the dairy FMCG firm.

headline: MTNL extends Rajiv Kumar's additional charge
summary: DoT extends MTNL Director (Finance) additional charge to BSNL's Rajiv Kumar for 3 months from Dec 1, 2026, pending ACC approval.

headline: 3i Infotech: Capital NxT LLP revises stake disclosure
summary: Capital NxT LLP and Persons Acting in Concert revised their Regulation 29(1) disclosure for 3i Infotech. The revised filing confirms a post-acquisition holding of 11.05% after acquiring shares on September 22, 2026.

headline: Kingsman Wealth sells Gujjubhai shares
summary: Kingsman Wealth Management, a promoter group entity, sold 28,697 equity shares of Gujjubhai Industries in the open market on November 25, 2026.

headline: Randar Businesses raises stake in Sharp Investments
summary: Randar Businesses Pvt Ltd acquired 2.46 lakh shares of Sharp Investments Ltd via market, raising its holding to 5.088% of paid-up capital.

headline: Dunearn cuts Global Health stake to 12.47%
summary: Dunearn Investments sold 63.7 lakh shares of Global Health Ltd in open market, reducing its holding from 14.84% to 12.47% as per SEBI disclosure.

headline: Promoter Times Growth buys 17,000 shares in Indo-City
summary: Times Growth Securities Ltd, a promoter group entity, acquired 17,000 equity shares of Indo-City Infotech Ltd in the open market, raising its stake to 5.61%.

headline: Arisinfra promoter revises SAST disclosure
summary: Siddharth Bhaskar Shah filed a revised Regulation 29(2) disclosure for Arisinfra Solutions, correcting pledged share data. Post-acquisition holding stands at 21.01%.

headline: BCCL fined ₹11.94 lakh by NSE and BSE
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Ltd faces combined fines of ₹11.94 lakh from NSE and BSE for governance non-compliance in Q2FY27. The penalties stem from board composition and committee constitution lapses.

headline: Gretex files RHP for Shreyas Fabtech IPO
summary: Gretex Corporate Services filed the Red Herring Prospectus for Shreyas Fabtech's NSE Emerge listing. The issue opens December 7, 2026, with a proposed listing date of December 14, 2026.

headline: L&T Finance CEO resigns effective Jan 2027
summary: Jinesh Shah, Chief Executive of Urban Secured Assets & Third Party Products at L&T Finance, has resigned. His cessation is scheduled for January 30, 2027.

headline: GRSE fined ₹9.77 lakh by NSE and BSE for governance lapses
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd received fines of ₹9,77,040 from NSE and BSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR provisions regarding independent director appointments.

headline: IOC fined ₹14.47 lakh by BSE, NSE for board non-compliance
summary: Indian Oil Corporation received fines of ₹14.47 lakh each from BSE and NSE for failing to appoint requisite independent directors in Q3FY26. The company cited government appointment delays as the cause.

headline: 3C IT Solutions to enter data privacy sector
summary: 3C IT Solutions & Telecoms board approves MOA/AOA changes to act as a Consent Manager under the DPDP Act, 2023. EGM notice approved for shareholder approval.

headline: BF Utilities fined ₹8.02 lakh by NSE, BSE
summary: BF Utilities Limited paid fines of ₹4,01,200 each to NSE and BSE for failing to appoint an Independent Woman Director. The company has since appointed a new director.

headline: NDTV RTA shifts office address effective Dec 2026
summary: KFin Technologies, NDTV's RTA, relocates its corporate office to Hyderabad from December 1, 2026. All shareholder communications must be directed to the new address.

headline: Oswal Agro completes postal ballot dispatch
summary: Oswal Agro Mills completed dispatch of postal ballot notice via electronic mode on November 27, 2026. Voting opens November 30 and closes December 29, 2026.

headline: E2E Networks wins Rs 136 Cr GPU cloud order from AI firm
summary: E2E Networks secured a Rs 136 crore contract for GPU cloud services. This order represents ~94% of avg quarterly revenue. Recent quarters show strong revenue growth and high margins.

headline: RCF fined ₹9.41 lakh each by NSE and BSE
summary: Rashtriya Chemicals & Fertilizers received fines of ₹9.41 lakh each from NSE and BSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations regarding board composition for Q3FY26.

headline: BPCL approves ₹1.26 lakh crore Ramayapatnam refinery
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd board approved a greenfield refinery and petrochemical complex at Ramayapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, with a capex of ₹1,26,656 crore.

headline: NLC India fined ₹10.47 lakh each by BSE, NSE
summary: NLC India Limited received penalties of ₹10,47,840 each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with SEBI LODR board composition norms. The company has requested a waiver citing government appointment constraints.
